subject: Temporary sandbox uplift to cover CI queue backlog
messages:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cloudharbor.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sandbox throughput hiccup blocking CI — request for short-term uplift

Hi Irene,

We're seeing a sudden spike in CI runs this week after merging a SAML auth change across a few services. Our test harness is hammering the sandbox environment and we've exceeded our quota, which is now failing a bunch of end-to-end pipelines. The engineering team is blocked on feature validation and we estimate this will take ~10 days to stabilize.

Can Redwood provide a temporary sandbox uplift (safety-net credits) and a short extension on our pilot window so we don't lose momentum? Specifically, we'd need enough capacity to cover ~150k tokens/day for the next 10 days — whatever shape that takes on your side (credits, quota bump, or a short-term dedicated sandbox).

I attached the top-of-log snippets and our current usage CSV for context.

Support ticket: SUPPORT-9876 (created with our CSM).

Thanks for any fast help here — our release is time-sensitive and this is the gating issue.

— Alex
Alex Taylor
Lead DevOps Engineer, CloudHarbor
alex.taylor@cloudharbor.io
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: ci_error_log.txt (text)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox throughput hiccup blocking CI — request for short-term uplift

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick note and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear you're blocked.

High-level next steps from our side:
- I need a quick confirmation of your estimated fix ETA (you noted ~10 days) and whether that aligns with your release window.
- David, can you assess the impact from an ops perspective and recommend an uplift size (credits or quota) that we can issue quickly?
- Marissa, I may need a short promo approval to issue a safety-net sandbox credit and a 2-week pilot extension if the uplift is material.

Alex — if you can confirm the ETA and the primary billing contact (for official amendment), I'll push this through with priority. We can do a temporary credit + extension while your team stabilizes.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox throughput hiccup blocking CI — request for short-term uplift

Irene / Marissa — reviewing Alex's logs now. Quick notes:
- The CI noise looks like repeated end-to-end runs rather than a single runaway job, so a quota bump is the right short-term fix.
- To cover ~150k tokens/day for 10 days with safety margin, I'd recommend issuing 500k token sandbox credits (this gives buffer and avoids multiple manual increments).
- We can also temporarily raise their concurrency throttle on the sandbox route to smooth the load. That requires a config change but is low-risk.

If marketing/account wants to avoid token-based language externally, we can present this as a "sandbox capacity uplift (one-time) + 2-week pilot window extension."

If you approve 500k tokens (equivalent credit), I can prepare the internal ticket to apply the uplift and add the throttling guard.

— David
David Kim
SRE, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai
